title: viewer.join (viewer → relay, first message)
description: Join by a typed or deep-linked code, or rejoin by sessionId + viewerToken after a disconnect. Exactly one of `code` or (`sessionId` + `viewerToken`) is present (docs/protocol.md §5.1). Every property is declared here; the oneOf only states the required/forbidden sets (generator spike, shared/README.md).

clientInfo.description: clientInfo.platform SHOULD be one of web | quest-browser | quest2 | quest3 | other and clientInfo.profile is informational (§5.1); receivers treat unknown platform values as other (§14).

oneOf.$comment: Join by code: no sessionId, no viewerToken (§5.1).
